$comment: Owner: hep-detector (contracts CV-C1; geant4 program C1.1, section C.4.4). design-search-spec/1: the search spec of evaluate_design.py search, hashed before the first evaluation and recorded in the search_summary. Only keywords contracts/schema.py implements: the limit of 4 objectives, the upper bounds of ranges and slot counts, and the cross-field rules (a requirement exists in the design-spec, a figure of merit is in the adequacy table, a parameter ref exists in the base candidate or the role rules, a role is in subsystem_roles and the role rules, ranges lie inside the role rules) are checked in Python (evaluate_design.py check_search_spec).

slots.$comment: roles whose subsystems the search may add or remove: [min, max] or {range, ids}; at most one subsystem per role (main's granularity), checked in Python

regenerate_budgets.$comment: base subsystems whose budget rows the role-rule model replaces (default: none; a subsystem the search adds always gets model rows)

geant4.$comment: Geant4 search values arrive in C2; C1 accepts only 0

p_mutation.$comment: per gene; default 1 / number of genes

min_improvement.$comment: relative hypervolume improvement over the window

reference_point.$comment: 'auto': each objective's threshold moved towards worse by a factor 1.1; an objective without a threshold declares reference_point itself

proposals.$comment: seed designs written by the designer (proposer llm); they take the same decoding, validity and evaluation as random designs

consistency_samples.$comment: points recomputed with evaluate_design.py run besides the finalists (default 20)

inline_points_max.$comment: above this many distinct designs the points go to a JSON Lines file (default 2000)

requirement.$comment: a requirement or constraint id of the design-spec (with or without the design_id namespace)

tool.$comment: TOOL:OPERATION when several F1 operations compute the figure of merit
